verdict.rationale: AI-generated insights are a fair axis for terminal emulators, since some terminals ship built-in AI assistants. Nothing in WezTerm's evidence shows any AI feature. The documented capabilities (searchable scrollback, Quick Select, the CLI with get-text, Lua events) are a non-AI search feature, a pattern-matching feature and developer building blocks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
